title: Veyra
subtitle: Agency Landing Page — Build Better. Move Faster. Grow Smarter.
role: Product Designer / UI Designer / Frontend Developer
overview: Veyra is a digital design, development and growth agency supplying skilled remote teams to businesses and startups. The landing page uses a modern B2B layout — strong typographic hierarchy, high-contrast CTA accents and visual social proof — to move visitors from headline to project inquiry.
problem: Remote-team agencies all sell the same abstract promise: talented people, on demand. Their landing pages usually lead with a wall of capability copy or a portfolio grid that says nothing about how the agency works. Either way the visitor is left asking who they'll work with, what working together looks like, and how to start without a heavy commitment.
solution: A structured single-page narrative that moves from promise to proof to action: a three-beat hero headline, a plain-language subheadline and a dual-action CTA, anchored by a dashboard-style visual. Below it, three service pillars, a team headshot wall, a grid of operational promises, a dark FAQ and social proof close the loop before the final conversion block.

features.title: Hero & Value Proposition
features.description: A three-beat headline — Build Better. Move Faster. Grow Smarter. — with a plain-language subheadline, a dual-action CTA group and a persistent primary button in the header.

features.title: Dashboard Hero Visual
features.description: An interactive dashboard preview showing sessions, activity, team members and metrics, positioning the agency in software and product design rather than abstract marketing.

features.title: Three Service Pillars
features.description: Design, Development and Growth surfaced directly beneath the hero with minimal line icons and one-line descriptions of the work each discipline covers.

features.title: Team Showcase
features.description: A collaged wall of real headshots around a central focus image under the headline A Team That Works With You, humanising the remote delivery model.

features.title: Why Work With Us
features.description: A 2x2 grid built on soft pastel icon containers covering Experienced Team, Flexible Approach, Clear Communication and Reliable Delivery.

features.title: Support & FAQ
features.description: A high-contrast dark section that breaks the page's rhythm, pairing a left-hand value checklist with a right-hand accordion that answers buying objections in place.

features.title: Client Social Proof
features.description: A bright accent-blue banner declaring FLEXIBLE — No complicated setup, followed by a three-column card grid of testimonials with avatars and roles.

features.title: Conversion Banner & Footer
features.description: A minimal closing CTA — Ready to Build Something Great? with a Start Your Project button — and a dark footer organising Company, Services and Legal links.

architecture.title: Scroll-Driven Section Narrative
architecture.description: The page is structured as a single scrolling narrative rather than independent blocks. Each section answers the next question a visitor is asking, so a cold reader is carried from headline to inquiry without a separate nav route. Background tone is the pacing tool: light gray for content, deep navy for the FAQ and bright blue for the social proof banner, marking transitions without extra dividers.
highlights: Three-beat headline hierarchy that compresses the value proposition into one scannable line
Dual-action CTA pairing a high-contrast primary button with a low-commitment secondary link
Alternating background tones to pace a long single page
Bold lead-ins inside body copy so key values can be skimmed
Real face imagery throughout to humanise an otherwise abstract remote service

results.description: Header, hero, mid-page, and closing conversion points
Hero through footer, each answering one visitor question
Product-led visual instead of stock agency imagery
Dark rhythm-break section with accordion answers

sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.content:
Veyra is a digital design, development and growth agency providing skilled remote teams for businesses and startups. The landing page uses a modern B2B layout — strong typography, high-contrast CTAs and visual social proof — to drive project inquiries.

The organising principle was sequence: each section answers the question a visitor asks at that scroll depth, closing objections in the order they surface.

sections.title: Hero & Value Proposition
sections.content:
The header stays uncluttered: Demos, Pages, Support and Contact, with a persistent Get started free button.

Build Better. Move Faster. Grow Smarter. is three beats of three words, so it survives a one-second glance and still reads as a complete promise. The subheadline translates it into plain language: a skilled remote team for design, development, content and digital support.

The CTA pairs a high-contrast Start a Project button with an Explore Services link. The hero visual is an interactive dashboard preview, anchoring the agency in product design rather than stock photography.

sections.title: Core Service Pillars
sections.content:
Directly beneath the hero, three competencies appear with minimal icons:

- Design: Visual experiences, product interfaces and brand identity
- Development: Web solutions, digital products and custom code
- Growth: Content strategies and audience engagement

Keeping the offer next to the proof means the visitor sees the work and the disciplines behind it without scrolling.

sections.title: A Team That Works With You
sections.content: Real headshots are collaged around a central focus image, reinforcing dedicated expertise, flexible collaboration and unified skill sets. Remote services carry an invisible objection — who am I talking to? — and a wall of real faces answers it faster than any testimonial.

sections.title: Why Work With Us
sections.content: A 2x2 grid with soft pastel icons covers Experienced Team, Flexible Approach, Clear Communication and Reliable Delivery. The calmer tone contrasts with the high-contrast CTAs, reading as reassurance rather than a second sales push.

sections.title: Support & FAQ
sections.content: A dark background marks a rhythm change where the page would feel long. A left-hand value checklist answers why to reach out, while a right-hand accordion resolves buying objections in place, so a visitor can settle a doubt without leaving.

sections.title: Client Social Proof
sections.content: A blue banner — FLEXIBLE: No complicated setup. — attacks the biggest barrier to buying a remote team: perceived commitment. Below it, a three-column grid of testimonials with avatars and roles borrows authority from recognisable job titles.

sections.title: Conversion & Footer
sections.content: The page closes on one hook: Ready to Build Something Great? with Start Your Project. The footer returns to dark mode and organises Company, Services and Legal links alongside social icons and a short mission tagline.

sections.title: Design Strengths
sections.content:
- Clear visual rhythm: alternating light, navy and blue backgrounds keep long sections engaging
- Scannable hierarchy: bold lead-ins let visitors skim core values
- Humanised angle: real faces reassure clients about who they'll work with

sections.title: Growth Opportunities
sections.content:
- Align hero CTAs: the header reads Get started free while the hero reads Start a Project — one consistent action would reduce cognitive load
- Strengthen testimonials: company logos alongside client titles would add organisational authority
